title: Quaintly Crispy Canadian Duck Skewers
description: A romantic Canadian dish featuring redcurrants and crispy duck, perfect for a special occasion, with a high protein content for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, maple syrup, rice vinegar, and olive oil to make the marinade.
Add the duck pieces to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated duck pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the sous-vide machine and cook for 2 hours.
While the duck is cooking, prepare the redcurrant sauce by heating the redcurrants and garlic in a saucepan over medium heat.
Once the duck is cooked, remove it from the sous-vide machine and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat a large skillet over high heat and add a small amount of olive oil.
Sear the duck skewers in the skillet for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the duck skewers hot with the redcurrant sauce spooned over the top.
